confidence_notes: Food and coffee anchors rest on aggregator and Vietnam-wide price sources that disagree with each other, so they are bounded estimates. Cocktail rests on one Hue bar review. Wine is set from the beer price by ratio because no usable wine data was found. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate; no live listings or booking pages were checked. The FX value was taken from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open directly. A third-party figure for 16 October (0.6947) differed slightly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Hue meal anchors draw on Hue-specific aggregator estimates (Wise, Expat Exchange). Coffee and beer draw on Vietnam-wide aggregator prices (Trek.zone, BearSavings). Cocktail draws on one Hue bar review. Wine uses an assumed multiple of about 4x the beer anchor. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Central Vietnam tourist city.
